name: Gel Electrophoresis Band Quantification
description: You are a biochemist quantifying protein expression levels from a gel electrophoresis experiment. Open the built-in 'Gel' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Gel). Use ImageJ's gel analysis workflow to: (1) define all visible lanes in the gel, (2) generate lane intensity profiles with background subtraction, (3) identify and measure the integrated optical density (area under the peak) for each detectable band, and (4) express each band's intensity as a percentage of the strongest band in its lane. Save a results table with columns for lane number, band position (pixels from top), background-corrected integrated intensity, and relative intensity percentage to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/gel_quantification.csv. Login: username 'ga', password 'password123'.
